subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should session-bound managed-image bytes returned by `artifacts.download` remain under the existing `operator.read` artifact contract, or must this path require `operator.admin`?
rationale: The patch deliberately extends read-scoped artifact downloads to local managed image bytes after multiple provenance checks; code review cannot choose that permanent authorization boundary without Gateway-owner intent.

options.title: Approve operator.read
options.body: Treat coordinate- and transcript-bound managed images like the other transcript-derived artifact bytes already exposed through the read-only artifact RPC family.

options.title: Require operator.admin
options.body: Tighten the RPC method and align protocol wording, UI recovery behavior, authorization tests, and live proof to the admin-only contract.

recommendation.title: Approve operator.read
recommendation.body: Treat coordinate- and transcript-bound managed images like the other transcript-derived artifact bytes already exposed through the read-only artifact RPC family.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion specifically routes the Gateway authorization-contract question to this person, whose recent work also covers the adjacent managed-image HTTP path.
